questions.instruction: Which equation represents this sentence? Two added to three times a number m is the same as 18.
questions.stem: Which equation represents this sentence? Two added to three times a number m is the same as 18.
skill_tags: Translate sentences into equations

answer.explanation: Preserve the direction of subtraction and group the entire sum after “times”.

steps.text: Underline the key words: sum → +, difference → −, product/times → ×, quotient/divided by → ÷.
steps.ar: ضع خطاً تحت الكلمات المفتاحية: مجموع ← +، فرق ← −، حاصل ضرب ← ×، ناتج قسمة/مقسوم على ← ÷.
steps.why: Each key word tells you which operation to write.
steps.why_ar: كل كلمة مفتاحية تحدد العملية التي نكتبها.

steps.text: "Three times a number m" = 3m; "two added to" it = 3m + 2; "is the same as 18" = 18.
steps.why: "is", "is the same as", "equals" become the = sign.
steps.why_ar: الكلمات "يساوي"، "هو نفسه" تصبح إشارة =.

steps.text: Write the equation.

questions.instruction: Describe the translation of g(x) relative to the parent f(x)=|x|. Distances are in units.
questions.stem: Describe the translation of g(x) relative to the parent f(x)=|x|. Distances are in units. g(x)=\left|{x}\right| - 3
skill_tags: Apply translations to absolute value functions

options.text: no horizontal shift; no vertical shift

answer.explanation: In |x−h|+k, h=0 and k=-3.

steps.text: Compare g(x) with the parent y = |x|. Write g in the form a·f(x − h) + k.
steps.ar: قارن g(x) بالدالة الأم y = |x|. اكتب g على الصورة a·f(x − h) + k.
steps.why: Each of a, h and k controls one change, so reading them one by one avoids mixing them up.
steps.why_ar: كل من a و h و k يتحكم في تغيير واحد، وقراءتها واحداً واحداً تمنع الخلط.

steps.text: Inside the function: x − h moves the graph RIGHT h; x + h moves it LEFT h. Outside: + k moves UP, − k moves DOWN.
steps.ar: داخل الدالة: x − h تنقل المنحنى يميناً h، و x + h تنقله يساراً h. خارجها: + k لأعلى و − k لأسفل.
steps.why: The inside change works opposite to its sign because it changes x before the function acts.
steps.why_ar: التغيير الداخلي يعمل عكس إشارته لأنه يغيّر x قبل تطبيق الدالة.

steps.text: Multiplying by a: |a| > 1stretches, 0 < |a| < 1compresses, a negative a reflects in the x-axis.
steps.ar: الضرب في a: إذا كان |a| > 1 تمدد، وإذا كان 0 < |a| < 1 انكماش، و a السالبة انعكاس حول محور x.
steps.why: a multiplies every y-value, so it changes the height, not the left-right position.
steps.why_ar: a تضرب كل قيم y فتغيّر الارتفاع لا الموقع الأفقي.

steps.text: So the answer is option B.

questions.instruction: Determine whether the sequence is arithmetic. Choose the correct justification.
questions.stem: Determine whether the sequence is arithmetic. Choose the correct justification. -3,\ 1,\ 5,\ 9,\ldots
skill_tags: Construct arithmetic sequences

options.text: Not arithmetic; negative terms or decreasing terms are not allowed.
Not arithmetic; arithmetic sequences require a constant ratio.

answer.explanation: Consecutive differences: 4, 4, 4. An arithmetic sequence requires all differences to be equal.

steps.text: Subtract each term from the next one to find the differences.
steps.ar: اطرح كل حد من الحد الذي يليه لتجد الفروق.
steps.why: An arithmetic sequence adds the same number (the common difference d) every time.
steps.why_ar: المتتابعة الحسابية يُضاف فيها العدد نفسه (الأساس d) في كل مرة.

steps.text: All differences are equal, so it is arithmetic with d = 4.
steps.ar: كل الفروق متساوية، إذن المتتابعة حسابية والأساس d = 4.
steps.why: A constant difference — not a constant ratio — is what makes a sequence arithmetic.
steps.why_ar: الفرق الثابت (وليس النسبة الثابتة) هو ما يجعل المتتابعة حسابية.

steps.text: So the answer is option C.
steps.why: Always compare your result with every option: a wrong sign or a missing term is a common trap.
steps.why_ar: قارن ناتجك مع كل الخيارات: الإشارة الخاطئة أو الحد الناقص فخ شائع.

questions.instruction: Determine whether the sequence is arithmetic. Choose the correct justification.
questions.stem: Determine whether the sequence is arithmetic. Choose the correct justification. \frac{1}{2},\ \frac{3}{4},\ \frac{5}{8},\ \frac{7}{16},\ldots
skill_tags: Construct arithmetic sequences

options.text: Not arithmetic; consecutive differences are unequal.
Arithmetic; any sequence with four terms is arithmetic.

answer.correct_option_text: Not arithmetic; consecutive differences are unequal.
answer.explanation: Consecutive differences: 1/4, -1/8, -3/16. An arithmetic sequence requires all differences to be equal.

steps.text: Subtract each term from the next one to find the differences.
steps.ar: اطرح كل حد من الحد الذي يليه لتجد الفروق.
steps.why: An arithmetic sequence adds the same number (the common difference d) every time.
steps.why_ar: المتتابعة الحسابية يُضاف فيها العدد نفسه (الأساس d) في كل مرة.

steps.text: The differences are not all equal, so the sequence is NOT arithmetic.
steps.ar: الفروق غير متساوية، إذن المتتابعة ليست حسابية.
steps.why: One unequal difference is enough to say "not arithmetic".
steps.why_ar: فرق واحد غير متساوٍ يكفي للحكم بأنها ليست حسابية.

questions.instruction: Describe the vertical dilation relative to the parent function f(x)=x.
questions.stem: Describe the vertical dilation relative to the parent function f(x)=x. g(x)=5x
skill_tags: Apply dilations to linear functions

answer.explanation: Multiplication of every y-value by 5 is a vertical stretch.

steps.text: Compare g(x) with the parent y = x. Write g in the form a·f(x − h) + k.
steps.ar: قارن g(x) بالدالة الأم y = x. اكتب g على الصورة a·f(x − h) + k.
steps.why: Each of a, h and k controls one change, so reading them one by one avoids mixing them up.
steps.why_ar: كل من a و h و k يتحكم في تغيير واحد، وقراءتها واحداً واحداً تمنع الخلط.

steps.text: Inside the function: x − h moves the graph RIGHT h; x + h moves it LEFT h. Outside: + k moves UP, − k moves DOWN.
steps.ar: داخل الدالة: x − h تنقل المنحنى يميناً h، و x + h تنقله يساراً h. خارجها: + k لأعلى و − k لأسفل.
steps.why: The inside change works opposite to its sign because it changes x before the function acts.
steps.why_ar: التغيير الداخلي يعمل عكس إشارته لأنه يغيّر x قبل تطبيق الدالة.

steps.text: Multiplying by a: |a| > 1stretches, 0 < |a| < 1compresses, a negative a reflects in the x-axis.
steps.ar: الضرب في a: إذا كان |a| > 1 تمدد، وإذا كان 0 < |a| < 1 انكماش، و a السالبة انعكاس حول محور x.
steps.why: a multiplies every y-value, so it changes the height, not the left-right position.
steps.why_ar: a تضرب كل قيم y فتغيّر الارتفاع لا الموقع الأفقي.

steps.text: Compare g(x) with the parent y = x. Write g in the form a·f(x − h) + k.

steps.why: Each of a, h and k controls one change, so reading them one by one avoids mixing them up.

steps.text: Inside the function: x − h moves the graph RIGHT h; x + h moves it LEFT h. Outside: + k moves UP, − k moves DOWN.

steps.why: The inside change works opposite to its sign because it changes x before the function acts.

questions.instruction: Which description correctly gives the graph, domain and range?
questions.stem: Which description correctly gives the graph, domain and range? f(x)=\begin{cases}2x+4&x\le1\\-x+3&x>1\end{cases}
skill_tags: Identify and graph piecewise-defined functions

options.text: Closed (1,6), slope 2 to the left; open (1,2), slope −1 to the right. Domain ℝ; range ℝ.
Closed (1,6), slope 2 to the right; open (1,2), slope −1 to the left. Domain ℝ; range [2,∞).
Open (1,6), slope 2 to the left; closed (1,2), slope −1 to the right. Domain ℝ; range (−∞,6).
Closed (1,6), slope 2 to the left; open (1,2), slope −1 to the right. Domain ℝ; range (−∞,6].

answer.correct_option_text: Closed (1,6), slope 2 to the left; open (1,2), slope −1 to the right. Domain ℝ; range (−∞,6].
answer.explanation: Use each expression only on its interval. x=1 uses the first piece, giving 6; no value exceeds 6.

steps.text: Piece 1: 2x + 4 for x ≤ 1. At x = 1: 2(1) + 4 = 6, closed dot (≤), and it goes to the LEFT with slope 2.
steps.ar: الجزء 1: 2x + 4 عندما x ≤ 1. عند x = 1: 2(1) + 4 = 6، نقطة مغلقة (≤)، ويمتد لليسار بميل 2.
steps.why: Each piece is drawn only on its own interval.
steps.why_ar: كل جزء يُرسم على فترته فقط.

steps.text: Piece 2: −x + 3 for x > 1. At x = 1: −1 + 3 = 2, open dot (>), going RIGHT with slope −1.
steps.ar: الجزء 2: −x + 3 عندما x > 1. عند x = 1: −1 + 3 = 2، نقطة مفتوحة (>)، ويمتد لليمين بميل −1.
steps.why: Slope = change in y ÷ change in x; it measures steepness and direction.
steps.why_ar: الميل = التغير في y ÷ التغير في x؛ يقيس الانحدار والاتجاه.

steps.text: Domain: every x is covered → ℝ. Range: piece 1 gives y ≤ 6, piece 2 gives y < 2 → (−∞, 6].
steps.ar: المجال: كل x مغطاة ← ℝ. المدى: الجزء 1 يعطي y ≤ 6، والجزء 2 يعطي y < 2 ← (−∞, 6].
steps.why: The range is the union of the y-values of both pieces.
steps.why_ar: المدى هو اتحاد قيم y للجزأين.

steps.text: So the answer is option D.
steps.why: Always compare your result with every option: a wrong sign or a missing term is a common trap.

answer.explanation: Add 1 first, then take the greatest integer not exceeding the result.

steps.text: Substitute x = -1.75into the inside of the brackets first.

steps.why_ar: دالة أكبر عدد صحيح تعمل على القيمة الداخلية، لذا نحسبها أولاً.

steps.text: Take the greatest integer that is less than or equal to that value (go DOWN on the number line, also for negatives).

steps.text: Finish the rest of the formula (multiply / add).

skill_tags: Write a line in slope-intercept form given slope and one point

answer.explanation: The displacement between the given points is (4,-4). Add it again to the second point to obtain (8, -3).

steps.text: Find the slope (rise over run) between the two points.
steps.ar: أوجد الميل (الارتفاع ÷ المسافة الأفقية) بين النقطتين.
steps.why: Every pair of points on a line has the same slope.
steps.why_ar: كل زوج نقاط على المستقيم له الميل نفسه.

steps.text: Keep stepping with the same rise and run from a known point.
steps.ar: استمر بالخطوات نفسها (الارتفاع والمسافة الأفقية) من نقطة معلومة.
steps.why: Adding the same run and rise stays on the line.
steps.why_ar: إضافة المسافة والارتفاع نفسيهما تبقينا على المستقيم.

steps.text: Check the option point (8, -3): its slope from (0, 5) is also -1.
steps.ar: تحقق من نقطة الخيار (8, -3): ميلها من (0, 5) يساوي أيضاً -1.
steps.why: Same slope from a point on the line ⇒ on the same line.
steps.why_ar: الميل نفسه من نقطة على المستقيم يعني أنها على المستقيم نفسه.

steps.text: So the answer is option D.
steps.why: Always compare your result with every option: a wrong sign or a missing term is a common trap.
steps.why_ar: قارن ناتجك مع كل الخيارات: الإشارة الخاطئة أو الحد الناقص فخ شائع.
